Maintenance
Maintenance Schedule
EVERY MONTH
l Test the safety reversal system. Adjust if necessary, see page 31.
l Check to be sure the door opens and closes fully.
EVERY YEAR
l Oil door rollers, bearings and hinges. The opener needs no other lubrication.
l Test the battery backup and consider replacing the battery.
SERVICE SCHEDULE
Fuel tube Check Every 2 years (Replace if necessary)
Spark plug Check-adjust o 61
